positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description: I led a team of senior engineers and we followed a cycle of innovation for developing projects in the field of Identity and Access Management. That meant we discussed common problems in the area, brainstormed solutions and ranked them based on potential feasibility so that we could build a quick yet feature-complete prototype for selected customers. We would then gather feedback and iterate on areas that we believed might needed further research or probing. Our goal was to demonstrate our company’s ability to solve challenging problems and to lay the foundations for other teams if or when our prototypes were selected as commercially viable by management. Given the nature of our work, we were not tied to a specific technology but we mostly developed using Python, C# and Node.js services hosted as a Google Cloud serverless Backend for a Frontend built in Vue.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Development · OAuth · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Machine Learning · NoSQL

company.name: Thales Digital Identity and Security (ex Gemalto)

positions.title: Software Developer Engineer
positions.description: Backend and Frontend development of a Web Service providing knowledge augmentation for Office apps based on text queries.  I was responsible of the service infrastructure, monitoring and telemetry, NLP component integration and UI implementation. Backend development on Azure cloud servers with C# and Frontend development on HTML with TypeScript and Knockout.js.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Development · Microsoft Azure · Natural Language Processing (NLP)

positions.title: Research intern
positions.description: Design and development of a Bayesian forecasting multi-model to merge different model predictions of air quality with historical data and produce estimations with stronger belief. Developed on Windows with Octave.
positions.insights: Skills: Linear Regression · Artificial Neural Networks

positions.title: Software developer intern
positions.description: Development of a new feature in Oracle’s data replication product, Oracle GoldenGate, to enable automatic encryption on different modules when user entered a global command. Developed on Linux Enterprise with C.

positions.title: Roboticist
positions.description: Design and development of a robotic navigation system based on Artificial Intelligence techniques for path planning and map localization with natural landmarks. Developed on Ubuntu with C++.
